// UNITS_S9F_2: Values below are real ps, sized at 2.5% of the 1750 ps sys_clk period for setup / 1.5% for hold (same basis as cpu/, gpu/ and template/ configs), applied against the dominant fabric clock. CAUTION: LibreLane's PL/GRT_RESIZER_*_SLACK_MARGIN is a single global knob, not per-clock-domain -- it also applies to the 780 ps cpu_clk domain, which as of run 19 (docs/PHASE5_RUN_HISTORY.md) is at -32.3 ps (target not met). A real margin on top of an already-negative domain may push the resizer harder there (plausibly helpful) or may fail to converge within this global setting -- neither has been exercised under real ps margins yet.
